description: Turn any word into an acrostic poem — one poetic line per letter from built-in line banks.

faqs.a: An acrostic spells a word with the first letter of each line; here each line starts with the next letter of your word.
Each letter has several hand-written poetic lines to choose from.
faqs.q: Where do the lines come from?
Can I use a name instead of a word?
faqs.a: Yes — any word or name up to 12 letters works; each line starts with the next letter.

title: Acrostic Poem Generator
